text:
Rina: Heads-up from a customer workshop: they want a single chat turn to orchestrate multiple tool calls (3-6), some in parallel, some ordered. Key asks: per-call timeouts, capped retries across the turn, and results-as-available streaming.
Omar: We should not invent implicit behavior. Propose an explicit `invoke_plan` shape with `mode` (parallel|ordered|hybrid), per-call `timeout_ms`, `retries_allowed`, and optional `order_index`.
Ben: MVP constraints: support `parallel` with streaming and `ordered` (strict sequencing) as two modes. Hybrid where you can tag groups that must be ordered inside a group but groups run in parallel could be future work.
Tess: Observability requirements: per-call tracing id, attempts, latency_ms, bytes, and cost_units. Need a trace_id at the chat-turn level to tie everything together.
Rina: Security: outbound integrations increase risk. For Private deployments require allowlist + KMS for idempotency tokens. Surface a warning if a customer enables retries for non-idempotent calls.
Omar: API sketch (in thread): mode and invocations array. We'll include `emit_partial:true` to stream each call's result immediately.
Ben: Retry policy: support per-call `retries_allowed` and a `global_retry_budget` for the whole turn. Runtime should prefer distributed retries but must not exceed budget. Document that non-idempotent calls must include `idempotency_key` to get retries.
Tess: Performance: parallel fanout multiplies egress and backend connections. Define per-turn concurrency cap (default 3, account cap 6). Perf acceptance: p95 end-to-end latency under target for a given concurrency level.
Rina: Launch criteria suggestion: API spec + SDK snippets (JS/Python streaming), perf tests, security review, per-invocation telemetry and billing attribution, one enterprise canary.
Omar: Non-goals for MVP: distributed transactions, automatic compensation, long-running sagas. We'll capture those for roadmap.
Ben: Action items: Omar + Ben draft RFC with exact JSON schema and sample SDK code; Tess to define telemetry + perf tests; Rina to coordinate enterprise POC and security review. Target: RFC in 2 weeks, internal alpha in 6 weeks.
sec-bot: Security issue created SEC-482: "outbound-invokes-review" assigned to security-team.
Rina: Also add small FAQ explaining ordering semantics vs. streaming and an example of how retries affect billing.
Omar: I'll include example OpenTelemetry spans and a recommended `ordering_hint` behavior for hybrid future work.
Tess: I'll simulate load: 1000 simultaneous turns x 4 calls to validate autoscaling.
Rina: Thanks all. We'll review the RFC in the next product sync.
